subject: Allocation & accounting treatment for pilot grant / credit memo request
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: how to provision pilot grant / promo credit for OptiScale

Hi Naomi + Marcus —

We closed the OptiScale pilot last week. They signed the pilot terms (attached) which include a $25k credit "grant" to cover Proof-of-Concept consumption. Sales wants to apply this proactively against their upcoming invoice 4372 instead of issuing a separate credit memo.

Two quick questions for finance:
- Is it OK to offset invoice 4372 with the $25k promotional grant (netting on the invoice), or do we need to issue a formal credit memo?
- If we offset, what GLA should we use for the accounting entry (promo expense vs sales credit)?

I attached the signed terms and the invoice. Deal ID RDW-DEAL-202704-OPTIS-112233 in HubSpot.

Thanks — can we get guidance today? Linda from OptiScale is asking for a timeline.

—Dylan
Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OptiScale_Pilot_Terms_20270428.pdf (pdf), Invoice_4372.pdf (pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: how to provision pilot grant / promo credit for OptiScale

Thanks Dylan — attaching initial read.

Quick notes:
- If the grant is explicitly part of the signed commercial terms and replaces consideration, accounting prefers a credit memo tied to the original invoice for audit trail. Offsetting is allowed operationally but we need documentation showing the credit reduces revenue.
- GL recommendation: debit Promo Expense (6102) / credit Accounts Receivable (1100) when issuing the credit memo. If offset on the invoice, we still post to 6102 but must tag the invoice with the grant reference.
- For internal approval: any promo > $10k needs Manager sign-off + Ops Controller acknowledgement.

Can Marcus confirm the GLA mapping and whether we should route this as CM (credit memo) or invoice offset?

—Naomi
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: HubSpot_112233_snapshot.png (screenshot)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T08:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: how to provision pilot grant / promo credit for OptiScale

Naomi — thanks. Confirming GL mapping and recommended flow:

1) Accounting treatment: Issue a credit memo for the $25,000.
   - Debit 6102 (Promo Expense) $25,000
   - Credit 1100 (AR) $25,000
2) Operationally we can apply the credit memo to invoice 4372 to net the customer's balance. We should not do a journal-level offset without a credit memo — that leaves an audit trail gap.
3) Required approvals: Manager (Naomi) and Ops Controller (me) to acknowledge. For credits tied to pilot grants, we also need a brief memo in the deal record documenting business rationale.

If that works, Soojin can confirm I'll prepare the CM draft and route to Naomi for sign-off.

—Marcus
Revenue Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Linda Cho <linda.cho@optiscale.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: how to provision pilot grant / promo credit for OptiScale

Appreciate the quick guidance. A couple of items from legal/sales ops:
- OptiScale would prefer a visible line item credit on the customer portal (so their admin sees the $25k grant). Applying a CM and then applying it to the invoice satisfies that.
- They also asked whether the credit can be split: $15k applied to invoice 4372 now, $10k held as a rolling credit for future invoices (valid 6 months). Is split treatment ok from an accounting perspective?

Marcus — can the CM be created with two lines (15k applied now, 10k unapplied) and the unapplied portion flagged with expiration metadata? If not, we'll need to issue two CMs.

Linda — looping you in so you're aware of the proposed flow and timing (we aim to have the applied portion on the portal within 3 business days after approvals).

—Soojin
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: how to provision pilot grant / promo credit for OptiScale

Soojin — technically we can do a split via two CM lines on a single credit memo but prefer issuing two separate CMs for clarity (audit + expiration tracking).

Proposed next steps:
- I'll draft two credit memos: CM-2027-OPTIS-01 ($15,000 applied to invoice 4372) and CM-2027-OPTIS-02 ($10,000 unapplied, expiration 2027-11-03).
- Naomi please confirm approval language; I'll attach the business rationale and link to HubSpot.
- Dylan/Soojin please confirm LinDA (OptiScale contact) is fine with split approach.

I'll prepare drafts and send for sign-off by tomorrow EOD.

—Marcus
Revenue Operations Lead

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Linda Cho <linda.cho@optiscale.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: how to provision pilot grant / promo credit for OptiScale

Marcus — approved.

Please proceed with two credit memos as proposed: CM-2027-OPTIS-01 (apply $15k to inv 4372) and CM-2027-OPTIS-02 (unapplied $10k, expiry 2027-11-03). Include the following note on each CM: "Pilot grant per signed OptiScale pilot terms, RDW-DEAL-202704-OPTIS-112233."

Marcus, once you post the CMs, cc accounting@redwood.com so they can reconcile the AR aging and post the promo expense. Dylan/Soojin — please notify Linda of expected timeline (CM posting + portal visibility ~ 3 business days).

Thanks all — closing this thread after CMs posted.

—Naomi
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: OptiScale_Pilot_Terms_20270428.pdf, Invoice_4372.pdf
